definitions.explanation: Medicine taken to stop diarrhea. The everyday word used in pharmacies and at home, in contrast with the technical {止|し}{瀉|しゃ}{薬|やく}.

examples.japanese: {下痢止|げりど}めを{飲|の}んだ。
{旅行|りょこう}には{下痢止|げりど}めを{持|も}って{行|い}った{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: You should take antidiarrheal medicine with you when you travel.

examples.japanese: {食中毒|しょくちゅうどく}が{疑|うたが}われるときは、{自分|じぶん}で{下痢止|げりど}めを{使|つか}わず{医師|いし}に{相談|そうだん}してください。
examples.english: If food poisoning is suspected, please consult a doctor rather than using antidiarrheal medicine on your own.

notes:
{下痢|げり} (diarrhea) + {止|ど}め, the noun form of {止|と}める (to stop). The same 〜{止|ど}め pattern names many household remedies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {下痢止|げりど}めを{飲|の}む: to take antidiarrheal medicine
- {下痢止|げりど}めが{効|き}く: the medicine works
- {市販|しはん}の{下痢止|げりど}め: over-the-counter antidiarrheal medicine

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {痛|いた}み{止|ど}め: painkiller — the same word-formation pattern
- {整腸|せいちょう}{剤|ざい}: intestinal regulator — settles the gut rather than stopping diarrhea outright
